title: Stop shipping agent files in published crates
description: Before 0.5.0 publish. Published 0.4.x crates include per-crate AGENTS.md, PLAN.md and (some) CLAUDE.md (verified in jmap-server-0.4.2.crate; 93 such files in the tree). Add to every published crate's Cargo.toml [package]: exclude = ["AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md", "PLAN.md"] (package.exclude is not inheritable from [workspace.package], so per crate; merge with any existing include/exclude). Verify with cargo package --list -p <crate> for all crates (none of the three files listed) and a cargo publish --dry-run of one crate. Published 0.4.x versions cannot be changed.
